messages:
Ava: FYI from the INC-2026 postmortem — we identified a recurring tail-latency pattern under bursty traffic. Proposed concrete test/eval additions: 1) regression prompt set targeting KV-eviction and repeated prefix cases, 2) a load-soak that replays the burst seq-length distribution we saw, 3) a chaos drill that simulates GPU preempt + automatic model fallback. Thoughts and owners?

Miguel: +1. Also want to add metric guards for p95/p99 token latency and a check on cache hit-rate regressions.

Sophie: I can own the prompt set. Plan to curate ~25 seeded prompts pulled from sanitized traces, add golden responses where possible. ETA: end of this week. Need access to the sanitized S3 bucket.

Ava: Thanks Sophie — @Sophie I will grant access to s3://redwood-incidents/sanitized by EOD.

Omar: I’ll take the load-soak. Will extend the existing k6 scripts to reproduce the burst pattern and run a 4-hour overnight soak in staging. Target: next Wed (reusable job). Note: will need a smaller agent pool to limit cost.

Kevin: I’ll hook the prompt set into CI as a nightly regression job and add a small smoke check to gate PRs. Proposal: 95% semantic match threshold for the prompt set. Do we want automated retries on flakiness?

Sophie: 95% seems fair; I’ll include golden outputs and a short rubric for human review if below threshold. For flaky runs: 2 auto-retries then open an investigation ticket.

Ava: For the chaos drill I propose Omar + Miguel own execution. Proposed date: 2026-04-10 10:00 UTC, 60-minute window. Will run GPU preempt scenario + model fallback to next-available variant. @oncall-bot can you create the event and incident placeholder?

oncall-bot: Created INC-DRILL-20260410 and invited eng-ml, eng-platform, eng-sre. Notes: game day includes GPU preempt, controlled KV eviction, and model fallback verification.

Miguel: I’ll add alerting for the latency gradients and update fallback policy docs. ETA: 3 days.

Ava: Action summary (please confirm): Sophie -> prompt set (EOW), Omar -> load soak job (next Wed), Miguel -> alerts + runbook (3d), Kevin -> CI + nightly hook (2d). I created a tracker page: https://redwood.internal/tracker/INC-2026-XX — add your PR links and any sub-tasks. We’ll review in sprint planning on Monday. Any objections?

Sophie: No objections. I’ll DM @Ava re: sanitized access details.

Omar: Sounds good. I’ll coordinate with eng-infra to provision a smaller pool so we don’t run up costs.

Kevin: Adding a small local dev script to trigger fallback so devs can reproduce without running the full chaos drill.

Ava: Perfect — I’ll convert these into JIRA tickets after this thread and assign owners there. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
